text: resolver/borrow CS-1/CS-2/CS-6 implementation review: a predicate's frame-escape walk stops at closures and ignores `break`/`continue` inside a loop body, so such predicates check and are enforced again (a `return` outside a closure, or `break`/`continue` outside a loop, is still E1211/E1103); a call to a local binding named `exit` does not count as diverging, so a move before it still poisons the fallthrough (E0601); E1103/E1211 descriptions updated (g01 M3815, M3816, M3818).
